remediatedFindings.resolution: Removed public shared-cache headers from the auth-aware middleware response path.

Removed audience enrollment from the one-off Atlas path email; only the confirmation route can add newsletter membership.

Replaced @lhci/cli and http-server with a local Lighthouse runner and native static server; full npm audit reports zero vulnerabilities.
